import pandas as pd

# Create the dataframe from the provided table
data = {
    'Year': [1999, 2000, 2001, 2001, 2002, 2002, 2002, 2002, 2003, 2003, 2003, 2003, 2004, 2004, 2006, 2007, 2007, 2008, 2008, 2012],
    'Competition': ['European Junior Championships', 'World Junior Championships', 'World Championships', 'Universiade', 'European Indoor Championships', 'European Indoor Championships', 'European Championships', 'European Championships', 'World Indoor Championships', 'World Indoor Championships', 'European U23 Championships', 'European U23 Championships', 'Olympic Games', 'Olympic Games', 'European Championships', 'World Championships', 'World Championships', 'Olympic Games', 'Olympic Games', 'European Championships'],
    'Venue': ['Riga, Latvia', 'Santiago, Chile', 'Edmonton, Canada', 'Beijing, China', 'Vienna, Austria', 'Vienna, Austria', 'Munich, Germany', 'Munich, Germany', 'Birmingham, United Kingdom', 'Birmingham, United Kingdom', 'Bydgoszcz, Poland', 'Bydgoszcz, Poland', 'Athens, Greece', 'Athens, Greece', 'Gothenburg, Sweden', 'Osaka, Japan', 'Osaka, Japan', 'Beijing, China', 'Beijing, China', 'Helsinki, Finland'],
    'Position': ['4th', '1st', '18th (sf)', '8th', '1st', '1st', '4th', '8th', '7th (sf)', '3rd', '1st', '1st', '6th', '10th (h)', '2nd', '3rd', '3rd', '6th', '7th', '18th (sf)'],
    'Event': ['400 m hurdles', '400 m hurdles', '400 m hurdles', '400 m hurdles', '400 m', '4x400 m relay', '400 m', '4x400 m relay', '400 m', '4x400 m relay', '400 m hurdles', '4x400 m relay', '400 m hurdles', '4x400 m relay', '400 m hurdles', '400 m hurdles', '4x400 m relay', '400 m hurdles', '4x400 m relay', '400 m hurdles'],
    'Notes': ['52.17', '49.23', '49.80', '49.68', '45.39 (CR, NR)', '3:05.50 (CR)', '45.40', 'DQ', '46.82', '3:06.61', '48.45', '3:03.32', '49.00', '3:03.69', '48.71', '48.12 (NR)', '3:00.05', '48.42', '3:00.32', '50.77']
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Identify years that have at least one '1st' place finish
years_with_first = df[df['Position'].str.contains('1st')]['Year'].unique()

# Identify all unique years in the dataframe
all_years = df['Year'].unique()

# Find years that are in all_years but not in years_with_first
years_without_first = [year for year in all_years if year not in years_with_first]

# Sort the list for consistent output
years_without_first.sort()

# Assign the final answer: a list of years with no 1st place finishes
answer = years_without_first
